title: A God-Plot on a Mining World
pitch: A Celestial once played god on a Thousand-Planet extraction world, then got bored and left. The plot didn't. The shrine still demands worship at every shift change, and the miners have started to give it.
The quota is due in nine days. The local Anti-Heaven chapter wants the shrine quiet before anyone counts the missing.
meta: Centre vs frontier, saints vs demons. The AI Narrator improvises the rest.

arc.beginning: The party arrives at the camp; the shrine and its worshippers; the first missing miner.
arc.middle: What the shrine is (a Celestial's abandoned plot), who benefits from it, and the chapter's pressure to end it quietly.
arc.end: Silence the shrine, expose it, or make a deal; nine days to the quota.

opening: Open at a shift change in the mining camp as the shrine's bell rings and every miner stops to kneel. The party is newly arrived for the local Anti-Heaven chapter.

zones.name: The mining camp
zones.summary: An extraction camp on a Thousand-Planet world; the shrine at its centre.

notes.text: The shrine: old stone, taller than the huts. Nobody walks or sees through it.
Spoil heaps from the mine: slow going.
The cut rock walls of the pit.
The camp: ore carts and fence lines to move between.
The haul road south of the spoil heaps: open, and the long way round.
